d:
Another quality oyakodon tale, unfortunately Part 1 has yet to be translated. Someone oughta start paying me to do these lol, but I'd be lying if I didn't have a lot of fun translating and photoshopping it.

If people are interested, I can upload the "clean RAWs" (which are just my photoshopping lots of text out) so fellow translators can translate this one without the hassle of editing out tons of text. Otherwise, I hope readers can appreciate how clean the English text looks side by side with the original Japanese text.
n: [Doujinshi] [Fujinoe Honpo (Fujinoe13B)] Mrs. Akiyama, My Part-Time Coworker 2: Oyakodon
